CHORUS_SPREAD_RANGE.doc: The chorus's right-leg phase offset, in TURNS of its one oscillator (§2, §3a; the native-FX catalogue's M32 Dimension row). The right leg's voice k reads the LFO at k/N + spread: 0 is both legs one phase (the stage without the field, bit for bit), 0.25 quadrature, 0.5 the Dimension's opposed sweep. A fraction of a cycle carries no engineering symbol, so the unit is ''.

CHORUS_RATE_RANGE.doc: The chorus sweep's speed (§3a). Above ~3 Hz it stops being a chorus and becomes a vibrato.

CHORUS_DEPTH_RANGE.doc: The chorus's peak-to-peak excursion above its declared 10 ms base (§3a).

CHORUS_VOICES_RANGE.doc: The chorus's tap count — one oscillator read at k/N (§3a).

CHORUS_MIX_RANGE.doc: The chorus's wet/dry, as an instance of DRIVE_MIX_RANGE — the same percent travel, its own come-up value: 35 %, a colour under the dry on a strip (§3a). The REVERB_LOWCUT_RANGE-over- REVERB_CUT_RANGE shape: one travel, one declared default per field that reads it.

CHORUS_BASE_MS.doc: The chorus's base delay, ms: the voices swing around it by up to the depth.

CHORUS_MAX_MS.doc: The longest delay a chorus voice reaches, rounded up to whole ms: the base delay plus the depth maximum. The delay line is sized from it.
